---
title: "topodata"
subtitle: "FesmData topography products"
---

## Overview

`topodata` reads a topography product of
[FesmData](https://github.com/fesmc/FesmData) (Topo v2),
`$ICE_DATA/v2/<Domain>/<GRID>/<GRID>_TOPO-<product>.nc`, as it is in the file.
It holds no model state: updates of the geometry belong to the caller (e.g.
htopo). Only the listed variables are loaded; the others stay unallocated
(one field of Antarctica at 1 km is about 180 MB).

| Variable | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `z_bed`, `z_srf`, `H_ice` | `real(wp)` | Bed and surface elevation, ice thickness (m) |
| `z_bed_sd` | `real(wp)` | Standard deviation of the bed elevation within the cell (m) |
| `f_ocn`, `f_land`, `f_grnd`, `f_flt` | `real(wp)` | Area fractions of ice-free ocean, ice-free land, grounded and floating ice |
| `mask` | `integer` | Dominant surface type: `topo_mask_ocean` (0), `_land` (1), `_grnd` (2), `_flt` (3) |
| `src_id` | `integer` | Source with the largest weight (names in `tab_src`) |

Missing values are `mv`. The global attributes `product` and `sources` of the
file are kept in `par`.

**Remapping**: given a target grid whose name differs from the grid of the
file, the real fields are remapped onto it with `remap` (default `"con"`,
conservative), `mask` and `src_id` by nearest neighbour. The grid of the
file is read from `grid_<GRID>.txt` next to the file, else from `maps/`; the
maps are cached in `maps/`. `mask` and `src_id` of target cells without a
source value are -1. A conservative map is partial where the target grid
reaches beyond the file's grid, so values there are means over the covered
part.

**Other files** (e.g. ISMIP7) are read too: `names` gives the variable of
the file for each entry of `vars`. A file without the global attribute
`grid_name` must be on the target grid (only its size is checked; no
remapping), as for custom basin sets in [regions](regions.qmd).

## Derived types

### `topodata_class`

| Component | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `par` | `topodata_param_class` | `path`, `vars(:)`, `names(:)`, `remap`, `grid_src` (`""` without `grid_name`), `grid_tgt`, `product`, `sources` |
| `nx`, `ny` | `integer` | Size of the fields (the target grid) |
| fields | see above | Allocated if listed in `par%vars` |
| `tab_mask`, `tab_src` | `flag_table_class` | Codes and names of `mask` and `src_id` (see [regions](regions.qmd)) |
| `remap`, `map`, `map_nn` | `logical`, `map_class` | Online remapping from the grid of the file |

## Public API

| Procedure | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `topodata_init_nml(td, filename, group, domain, grid_name, subs, grid, verbose)` | Load from a namelist group |
| `topodata_init_arg(td, path, vars, names, remap, grid)` | Load from arguments |
| `topodata_end(td)` | Deallocate |

## Namelist configuration

```
&topo
    path  = "ice_data/v2/{domain}/{grid_name}/{grid_name}_TOPO-BedMachine-v6.nc"
    vars  = "z_bed" "z_srf" "H_ice" "z_bed_sd"     ! optional; this default
    remap = "con"                                   ! optional; this default
/
&topo   ! another file
    path  = "ice_data/ISMIP7/{domain}/{grid_name}/obs/{grid_name}_ObsISMIP7-v1.3.nc"
    vars  = "z_bed" "H_ice" "z_srf"
    names = "bed" "thickness" "surface_grimp"       ! optional; "" = as vars
/
```

`{grid_name}` is the grid of the file; pass the model grid as `grid` to
remap onto it.

## Usage example

```fortran
use topodata

type(topodata_class) :: td

call topodata_init_nml(td, "par/test.nml", "topo", domain="Greenland", &
                       grid_name="GRL-1KM", grid=grid_model)

where (td%H_ice .gt. 0.0_wp) ...
```
